method: Hindsight, price-only. Close on the last trading day before the quarter to close on its last trading day (current quarter: to the latest close). Filters: start price >= $2; start market cap >= $75M (current market cap scaled by price); current average daily volume >= $1M. Only companies still in the dashboard are included, so acquired names (takeover winners) are missing. Returns are split-adjusted closes. Driver notes were researched from company and news sources; unverified where noted.
